title: QA basics retake
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this check. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: One section, 30 questions, 40 minutes. Every question is type-in (TITA): there are no options and no negative marks.
No calculator for this check, so the calculator button is hidden. You can use rough paper.
Type the number only, with no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction (1.5, not 3/2). Type a decrease as a negative number.
If you can't see how to start within about 30 seconds, leave it blank and move on.
If you answer but aren't sure, use Mark for Review & Next. The answer still counts, and the flag shows you which ones to recheck.
The site records how long you spend on each question, so you don't need to note slow ones.
Go in order. When the timer ends, the section submits itself.

questions.text: Express 7/8 as a percentage.
Convert 1/11 to a percentage, correct to two decimal places.
The price of a bag is cut by 30%. Later the new price goes up by 30%. What is the overall percentage change from the original price? Type a decrease as a negative number.
Rahul earns 60% more than Meera. By what percentage are Meera's earnings lower than Rahul's?
₹2,100 is shared between R and S in the ratio 4 : 3. How much does R get, in rupees?
Three numbers p, q and r add up to 62. If p : q = 3 : 4 and q : r = 6 : 5, what is r?
The average of 8 numbers is 25. One number is taken out, and the average of the other 7 is 23. Which number was taken out?
A grocer mixes 3 kg of sugar worth ₹42 a kg with 5 kg worth ₹50 a kg. What is the mixture worth per kg, in rupees?
A grocer has 6 kg of dal worth ₹120 a kg. How many kg of dal worth ₹96 a kg should she add so that the mixture is worth ₹104 a kg?
A lamp costs a trader ₹600. He sets its marked price 40% above cost, then sells it at 15% off the marked price. What percentage profit does he make?
₹8,000 is invested at 5% per annum, compounded annually. How much compound interest does it earn in 2 years, in rupees?
A sum lent at simple interest doubles in 16 years. What is the rate of interest per annum, in percent?
Neha rides her scooter from home to college at 20 km/h and comes back along the same road at 30 km/h. What is her average speed for the round trip, in km/h?
A 140 m train and a 110 m train approach each other on parallel tracks at 48 km/h and 42 km/h. From the moment their fronts meet, how many seconds pass until their rear ends are clear of each other?
Ravi can paint a wall in 12 hours and Sunil can paint it in 24 hours. Working together, how many hours will they take?
Going downstream, a boat covers 36 km in 2 hours. Coming back upstream over the same 36 km, it takes 3 hours. Find the speed of the stream in km/h.
Given 5x + 2y = 31 and 2x + 5y = 25, what is x + y?
The equation 2x² − 11x + 5 = 0 has roots m and n, where m > n. What is m − n?
Given x + 1/x = 5, find the value of x² + 1/x².
For how many integers x is |x + 4| < 6?
Find x if 16ˣ = 8. Type it as a decimal.
An uncle is now 5 times as old as his nephew. In 8 years he will be 3 times as old as his nephew. What is the nephew's present age, in years?
A circle has radius 13 cm, and one of its chords is 24 cm long. How far is the chord from the centre, in cm?
An equilateral triangle has sides of 8 cm. What is its area, in cm²? Take √3 = 1.732 and give the answer to two decimal places.
A regular octagon has 8 equal interior angles. What is each angle, in degrees?
How many positive whole numbers divide 144 exactly?
3¹¹ is divided by 13. What is the remainder?
Which is the smallest three-digit number that gives a remainder of 3 on division by 4, by 6, by 9 and by 12?
What do the first 12 terms of 5, 8, 11, 14, ... add up to?
A coach must pick 2 players from a squad of 7. How many different pairs can she pick?
